entries.name: MeadowGenerate
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production transparent Unity pixel monster two-frame atlas. Input1 is APPROVED monster style and design reference: use ONLY LEFT column RETRO32 style, NOT right RETRO48. Input2 is actual recently approved game player rendering to harmonize with. Make a clean portrait 1024x1536 PNG alpha sheet, EXACTLY2columns x6rows,12 separate whole sprites, NO text labels/header/borders/ground shadows. Same monster in two animation frames per row. Rows TOP to BOTTOM: (1) grass green SLIME with small two-leaf sprout and two dark square eyes, (2) beige root SPROUT SPIRIT with two big green leaves, tiny arms and root feet, (3) green large-eared GOBLIN carrying brown wooden club and brown loincloth, (4) beige tiny mushroom fairy under RED cap with cream square spots, (5) brown side-facing BOAR with pink snout, cream tusks and bristly mane, (6) TREE GUARDIAN treant with trunk face, amber square eyes, mossy crown/shoulders, heavy root arms and feet. Preserve approved left-column silhouettes. Two frames are coherent small walk/bounce alternation: slime squash then slightly upright, root spirit alternating feet/leaf bob, goblin alternate feet with club bounce, mushroom alternate feet/cap bob, boar opposite gait legs, tree alternate root feet and swinging arms. Do not add particle effects. Same identity/scale/colors between each pair. Strict separated 512x256 logical cells: place sprite centers x256 and768 and row centers y128,384,640,896,1152,1408; plenty empty alpha gutter, all complete shapes inside their own cell. Normal actors about155-200px high (slime~145,root~175,goblin~195,mushroom~180,boar~190), guardian~220px high. Chunky old-school survivor-RPG pixel art, about24-32 logical pixels per normal sprite height, crisp visibly stepped square clusters, nearest-neighbor enlarged; same coarse grain in club, tusks, leaves and face. Minimal 3-4 flat tones per material, muted earthy greens/browns, soft low-contrast colored outlines, readable dark square eyes. No smooth painting, no tiny fur detail, no thin outlines, no strong white highlights, no bloom/glow/halo, no gradients, no antialiased edges. Truly transparent alpha background, no checkerboard drawn, no floor. Create original retro sprites based closely on the approved reference left column; no characters from commercial games.

entries.name: MeadowAnimationCorrection
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit plus background-extraction. Input1 edit target. Correct this monster production atlas with TWO mandatory changes. 1) REMOVE THE ENTIRE COLORED FOG/BACKGROUND AND EVERY GLOW HALO. Every pixel outside the twelve creature silhouettes must be truly alpha0 transparent, including empty gutters between sprites. No vignette, no shadows or aura, no backdrop, no colored haze. Preserve opaque monster interiors and clean square edges. 2) This is a TWO-FRAME ANIMATION sheet, not a style comparison: keep each LEFT-column monster design and coarse pixel density as canonical, and redraw its RIGHT-column mate to match EXACTLY that same character, scale and detail level. Especially right slime must be the simple left leaf-slime with same two square eyes and NO extra arm; right mushroom must have same cap spots as left. For frame2 only alternate feet, lower/raise body by at most ONE logical pixel and tilt leaves/club slightly, same bounding height within5%. All6 pairs should use LEFT-column coarse RETRO32 pixel grain, with no added detail. Keep species row order slime/sprout/goblin/red mushroom/brown boar/treeguardian, same canvas and two columns six rows with transparent gutters. Simple low contrast material-colored outlines instead of heavy black outline. No text. Frame animation subtle; do not create a higher-detail variant in second column.

entries.name: MeadowSoftTone
entries.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather / pixel palette edit. Edit target is the supplied 12-sprite meadow animation atlas. Preserve ALL shapes, silhouettes, coarse pixel sizes, face details, poses, two-frame pairs, spacing, cell positions and canvas exactly. ONLY soften the palette of OUTLINES and highlights: outer contours currently almost black must become lower-contrast desaturated material colors (olive around green leaves/slime/goblin, medium-dark warm brown around wood/boar, muted terracotta around red cap, tan-brown around beige flesh). Lift these outer outline colors modestly, around20-25percent toward the adjacent base material. Keep dark eyes and mouth readable. Reduce bright leaf/slime yellow-green saturation a little toward approved earthy olive. Dim shiny white highlight patches into pale cream/yellow-green; guardian eyes are small muted amber squares, no emitted light. Preserve all interior pixel art; do not smooth edges or add pixels. Remove any visible aura, light bloom or fog OUTSIDE silhouette; real alpha0 outside monsters. Full true transparency. No gradients, no resampling, no new detail or extra objects, no text. Same exact atlas with softer outlines and restrained highlights, not a redesign.

entries.name: DungeonDenizensGenerate
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent Unity2D dark stone-dungeon MONSTER atlas, NEW species designs. Input1 is APPROVED MEADOW monsters used ONLY as exact chunky pixel grain, restrained light and soft outline STYLE reference. Input2 is the approved hooded player style. Do NOT repeat the meadow species. Create1024x1536 alpha PNG, TWO columns xSIX rows =12 whole separate sprites, with each row a matched two-frame animation of one creature. Top-to-bottom species: 1 CAVE BAT: squat charcoal-purple body, two small pointed ears, muted mauve wing membranes, dark bead eyes, frame1 wings spread/up and frame2 wings lowered, same body center; 2 UNDERGROUND RAT: stocky slate-brown rat in side three-quarter view, pointed pink nose, round ears, thin curled tail, tiny paws walking alternate; 3 CHAIN GHOST: pale grey-blue hoodless floating wraith with hollow dark face, ragged tapered lower body, dull iron wrist shackles and short simple chain links, frame2 cloth sway, NO glow; 4 STONE SPIDER: squat spider with grey stone-plated abdomen with small dull violet rune, eight chunky articulated legs (four per side), low profile, alternate leg gait; 5 HAUNTED ARMOR: empty dark slate iron helmet with narrow muted violet eye slit, blocky breastplate/shoulder plates, dark blue torn waist cloth and iron boots, carrying short chipped rusty sword, no skeleton visible, alternate boots/sword bob; 6 SEALED GATE WARDEN BOSS: imposing ancient rectangular stone arch-door golem, a sealed door with carved subdued cyan rune in its chest, blocky heavy stone fists and rootless stone legs, chain cuffs, weathered slate and muted bronze hinges, narrow small cyan eyes, no skull/ribs/bones, alternate heavy stomp. NO slime, NO goblin, NO mushroom, NO boar, NO shield skeleton, NO skull-and-bone golem. These six are entirely different silhouettes appropriate to a stone dungeon. Same design/size/pixel density between each row's two frames, not style variants. Strict2columns6rows with generous alpha gutters; normals~160-200px high and boss~220px high, whole silhouettes inside own row/column with no overlap. Faces and bodies stay readable at small survivor-game scale. Bold simple32logical-pixel-ish sprites enlarged nearest-neighbor, square color clusters and stair-step contours, 3tones per material, medium-dark low-contrast material-color outlines (not black), muted cool slate/violet/taupe, very modest highlights. Uniform coarse pixels on sword, chains, legs and all details. No smooth painting, no microdetails, no gradients or thin highlights. No light aura, bloom, fog, particles or floor shadows. Fully transparent alpha0 background outside sprite silhouettes, no background color, no labels, titles, dividers or drawn checkerboard.

entries.name: DungeonDenizensSpacing

Reduce BOTH knight sprites uniformly to about85percent of their current width and height, scaling around each knight's own center, at the same positions. Keep their approved armor/sword/eyes/torn cloth designs and coarse pixel cluster style, same two walking poses. This MUST create at least16pixels of COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT alpha0 full-width gutter between the spider row and knight row, and at least16px between knight row and gate-warden row. No knight pixels can overlap the spiders' vertical extent. Preserve every other sprite EXACTLY unchanged: two cavebats, two rats, two chain ghosts, two stone spiders, two stone gate wardens. Keep entire1024x1536 canvas and existing column positions, no resizing canvas or rearranging species. All non-sprite space alpha0 transparent. No labels, no background, no extra art, no effects, no changes to other rows. Keep sharp square-pixel edges, no smooth downscale blur, no new fine details. This is an atlas spacing fix, not a character redesign.

entries.name: DungeonDenizensSoftTone
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / palette correction. Preserve this entire12-sprite dungeon monster sheet EXACTLY: bat, rat, chain ghost, stone spider, the two now-smaller haunted knights, and gate warden boss. Keep all poses, spacing, dimensions, shapes, eyes, chain links, runes and pixel cluster positions. Make ONLY all outer outlines softer: replace near-black contour pixels with desaturated medium-dark charcoal grey, mauve-grey around bat wings, taupe-brown around rat and rust, slate-grey around stones and armor. Lift outer contour brightness moderately, about25percent toward adjacent surface color. Keep facial holes and eye pupils dark. No line thicker, no new strokes, no added detail. Flat restrained highlights, muted material shading, no glow or bloom. Keep crisp square stepped pixel edges with no smoothing or antialiasing. Actual alpha0 transparent background outside each silhouette, no extra shadows or effects. Essential: retain clear transparent gaps between ALL six rows, especially spider and knight rows; retain smaller knights and current composition. The goal is a subtle lower-contrast outline consistent with a soft retro pixel game.

entries.name: DungeonCoarseRedraw
entries.prompt: Use case: style-transfer, precise sprite-sheet restyle. Input1 is the EDIT TARGET: twelve dungeon sprites, in pairs across two columns and six rows. Input2 is STYLE REFERENCE: approved meadow sprites with the coarse rough retro pixel grain the user wants. Redraw ONLY the pixel rendering of Input1 to match Input2's bold chunky hand-placed dot clusters. Current dungeon pixels are too fine, smooth, regular, polished and detailed. Make them noticeably rougher and lower-resolution, like 24-32 logical pixels tall for normal creatures, 40 logical pixels for the large gate warden, enlarged nearest-neighbor. Use a consistent logical dot size about7-8 output pixels on the1024x1536 canvas. Outer silhouettes have clearly visible big square stair steps and irregular one/two/three-dot ledges, not finely traced curves. Replace smooth rounded shading and tiny texture specks with bold flat clusters in3 shades per material. Simplify inner facets rather than adding noise: bat wing membranes broad jagged blocks, rat fur broad solid planes, ghost cloak a few blocky folds, spider legs chunky jointed square segments, armor broad angular plates with no thin bevels, gate stones broad rough squared facets. Simplify chains into a few thick square links and rune into chunky square marks. Keep eyes readable square dots, subdued highlights, SOFT LOW-CONTRAST material-colored outlines, no heavy black outline, no glow/bloom. Preserve APPROVED SPECIES AND DESIGNS EXACTLY: row1 mauve cavebat, row2 slate-brown rat with pink nose/curled tail, row3 pale chained ghost, row4 stone spider with violet rune, row5 empty haunted iron armor with rusty sword/torn blue cloth, row6 stone arch-door gate-warden with chest cyan seal and chain cuffs. Keep all12 sprite positions, sizes, poses, palette, two-frame motion, relative proportions, exact1024x1536 canvas and clear transparent gutters between EVERY row and column; keep row5 knights smaller with clear gap to spiders/wardens. No new creatures, no replacement with slime/skeleton/goblin/mushroom/boar. Preserve transparency alpha0 outside sprite silhouettes. No lettering/background/fog/ground shadows. Make a real artistic pixel redraw with much larger visible pixel clusters, not a blur or noise overlay. All twelve dungeon sprites including weapons/chains/boss should have the same rough coarse pixel feel as the meadow reference.
